amos.3.p1.b1.text: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”

amos.3.p1.b2.text: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?

amos.3.p1.b3.text: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken— who will not prophesy?

amos.3.p1.b4.text: “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.”

amos.3.p1.b5.text: “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued …

amos.3.p1.b6.text: the horns of the altar will be cut off, and they will fall to the ground. … the houses of ivory will also perish …
